sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这也是为什么我认为英国人可能对威廉王子和凯特·米德尔顿的故事真正感兴趣的原因之一，对吧？

sentences.zh: 或者也许可以追溯得更远，回到现在的查尔斯国王、当时的查尔斯王子和戴安娜王妃，当然，他们的结局也非常悲惨。

sentences.zh: 就像戴安娜王妃一样，人们对肯尼迪家族的故事依然非常感兴趣，

sentences.zh: 评论区反映出读者们表示赞同。

sentences.en: Many readers say we're refusing to watch.
sentences.zh: 许多读者说我们拒绝观看。

sentences.en: You know, I can't account for the many, many, many others who are gobbling up the performance.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我无法解释那些成千上万、正在津津有味欣赏这场表演的人。

sentences.en: Some people think this is the price you pay for being famous.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为这是成名所必须付出的代价。

sentences.en: But also, I mean, if I was Daryl Hannah and, you know, nobody can get inside of a relationship.
sentences.zh: 但同时，我的意思是，如果我是达丽尔·汉纳，而且，你知道，没有人能真正走入一段关系中。

sentences.en: Who knows how she actually was.
sentences.zh: 谁知道她当时到底是怎样的呢。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But nonetheless, I mean, I can understand being really upset by having such a negative, unflattering portrayal of me out there that some people might think was true.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，我的意思是，我可以理解，当外面流传着关于自己如此负面、不讨喜的形象，甚至让一些人信以为真时，心里会感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: But that's what entertainment does.
sentences.zh: 但这就是娱乐业所做的事情。

sentences.en: It takes real stories and warps them all the time.
sentences.zh: 它一直在把真实的故事拿来扭曲。

sentences.en: This is not necessarily a new complaint.
sentences.zh: 这不一定是一个全新的抱怨。

sentences.en: And I just don't know, while I can understand why she'd be upset about this,
sentences.zh: 我只是不知道，虽然我能理解她为什么会对此感到不安，

sentences.en: I can't figure out where do we think the ethical boundaries are when it comes from taking true stories and fictionalizing them.
sentences.zh: 我弄不明白，当涉及到取材真实故事并将其小说化时，我们认为的道德界限在哪里。

sentences.en: You know, this old boss, this editor, the New York Observer, he'd say, if you run into a celebrity on the street, just interview them.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这个老老板，这位《纽约观察家报》的编辑，他会说，如果你在街上遇到名人，直接去采访他们。

sentences.en: Interview them.
sentences.zh: 去采访他们。

sentences.en: Just go right up to them.
sentences.zh: 直接朝他们走过去。

sentences.en: He said, yeah, he said they chose this life.
sentences.zh: 他说，对，他说这是他们自己选择的生活。

sentences.en: I'll never forget him saying that.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记他说过的话。

sentences.en: And, you know, he wasn't wrong.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他说得没错。

sentences.en: I mean, I get his point.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我懂他的意思。

sentences.en: But, you know, but OK, but in Daryl Hannah's case, if she had been interviewed, if she had been consulted, I mean, I think that's where the tension is.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，但是好吧，但在达丽尔·汉纳的例子里，如果她曾被采访过，如果她曾被征求过意见，我的意思是，我认为这就是矛盾所在。

sentences.en: It would have inoculated, right, exactly.
sentences.zh: 那就不会有争议了，对吧，完全如此。

sentences.en: If Ryan Murphy and his staff had been able to get the buy-in of – now, I think, on the other hand, they're portraying a whole family.
sentences.zh: 如果瑞恩·墨菲和他的团队能够获得——现在，我认为，另一方面，他们描绘的是整个家族。

sentences.en: So I think buy-in would have been difficult because, as we know, there are disagreements within the family.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为获得支持会很困难，因为如我们所知，家族内部也存在分歧。

sentences.en: And that's part of what he's portraying.
sentences.zh: 这也是他所刻画的内容的一部分。

sentences.en: So I think to get buy-in would have been very complicated.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为要获得各方支持会非常复杂。

sentences.en: But what he does have, going back to the idea that we're sitting here and talking about this, is attention from all of this.
sentences.zh: 但他确实拥有的是，回到我们坐在这里谈论这件事的这个概念，那就是来自这一切的关注度。

sentences.en: Attention.
sentences.zh: 关注度。

sentences.en: Have you ever heard of the Streisand effect?
sentences.zh: 你听说过芭芭拉·史翠珊效应吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 听过。

sentences.en: Reiterate for me what it is again.
sentences.zh: 再为我复述一下这是什么意思。

sentences.en: OK, so the Streisand effect – so Barbara Streisand once sued a photographer for taking a photo of her house in Malibu.
sentences.zh: 好的，所谓的史翠珊效应——芭芭拉·史翠珊曾经起诉了一名拍摄她在马里布房产照片的摄影师。

sentences.en: And what do you guess the result of this lawsuit was?
sentences.zh: 你猜这场官司的结果是什么？

sentences.en: Oh, everyone knew her address.
sentences.zh: 哦，所有人都知道她的住址了。

sentences.en: Everybody knows the house.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道那座房子。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Everybody knows.
sentences.zh: 所有人都知道了。

sentences.en: More people probably want to go to the house to see the famous Barbara Streisand lawsuit house.
sentences.zh: 可能有更多的人想要去那个房子看看那座著名的芭芭拉·史翠珊诉讼案房子。

sentences.en: And I would guess – and I have no data.
sentences.zh: 我猜——而且我没有数据。

sentences.en: I'm about to say something that I have absolutely zero data for.
sentences.zh: 我接下来要说的话是完全没有任何数据支持的。

sentences.en: But I'm going to guess that the number of people who have refused to watch the show because they side with Jack Schlossberg or Daryl Hanna is less than the number of people who are watching it because they want to be in the conversation and know what all the fuss is about.
sentences.zh: 但我要猜的是，那些因为站在杰克·施洛斯伯格或达丽尔·汉纳一边而拒绝观看该剧的人数，要少于那些为了参与讨论、想知道究竟在吵些什么而观看该剧的人数。

sentences.en: I mean, listen, if you are using publicity and the press in any way in your career, in your life, that changes the equation a little bit, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，听着，如果你的职业生涯或生活中在任何方面利用了宣传和媒体，那就稍微改变了等式，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, if you want the press when it's time to get your side of the story out there or your pictures out there or whatever,
sentences.zh: 比如，当需要把你的立场或你的照片公之于众时，你希望得到媒体关注，

sentences.en: but then you don't like it if other creative entities – you know, you want to make the rules for every portrayal of yourself, that's challenging.
sentences.zh: 但如果其他创意实体这样做——你知道，你想要为关于你自己的每一次刻画制定规则，那就很有挑战性了。

sentences.en: So,
sentences.zh: 所以，

sentences.en: the same fame that makes her vulnerable to what Ryan Murphy has done is the fame that enables her to place a highly read op-ed piece in the New York Times about what's happened.
sentences.zh: 使她容易受到瑞恩·墨菲所作所为伤害的那种名气，正是使她能够《纽约时报》上发表一篇备受关注的关于所发生事情的评论文章的名气。

sentences.en: You have to factor that into the math about how to feel about the situation.
sentences.zh: 你在对如何看待这种情况进行权衡时，必须把这一点计算在内。

sentences.en: It's interesting because in some ways, the op-ed, like the show, asks the audience to make a choice.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为在某些方面，这篇评论文章和节目一样，要求观众做出选择。

sentences.en: And the choice is, how much sympathy do you have?
sentences.zh: 而这个选择是，你有多少同情心？

sentences.en: How much empathy do you have for somebody, real or not, born into it or not, that has that kind of fame and privilege?
sentences.zh: 对于一个拥有那种名气和特权的人，无论是真是假，是否生来就有，你有多少同理心？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Alexandra Jacobs, always a pleasure to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉·雅各布斯，很高兴能与你交谈。

sentences.en: Rachel, I'm always available.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋，我随时都有空。

sentences.en: All too available.
sentences.zh: 简直是太有空了。

sentences.en: I'm not a rules girl when it comes to coming on The Daily.
sentences.zh: 说到上《每日新闻》，我可不是个循规蹈矩的女孩。

sentences.en: It was edited by Wendy Doerr, with help from Michael Benoit.
sentences.zh: 节目由温迪·多尔剪辑，迈克尔·伯努瓦提供了帮助。

sentences.zh: 包含由马里安·洛萨诺、丹·鲍威尔、黛安·王和艾丽西亚·拜蒂布创作的音乐。

sentences.zh: 由罗万·涅米斯托担任音频工程。

sentences.zh: 我们的制作经理是弗兰尼·卡托夫。

sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯。明天见。

sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们要为假期招待客做准备。

sentences.zh: 收听节目获取小贴士，让你的客人们宾至如归。

sentences.zh: 他们是全黑睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们喝到断片才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有对什么过敏，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
